title: Gospel
style: English, female vocal, soulful gospel, choir, Hammond organ, piano, handclaps, 76 bpm
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
When the morning finds me weary
And my road is long and steep,
There's a song that rises in me
From a well that's running deep.

[Chorus]
Lift me higher, lift me higher,
Set my weary soul on fire,
Every breath is a new beginning,
Lift me higher, keep me singing.

[Verse]
I have walked through every valley,
I have cried through every night,
But the wind blows through the alley
And it carries me to light.

[Chorus]
Lift me higher, lift me higher,
Set my weary soul on fire,
Every breath is a new beginning,
Lift me higher, keep me singing.

[Outro]
